description: Fetch one job posting by domain + jobId, or by HireJack detail URL. Returns title, company, location, salary, skills, seniority, posted date, visa/remote/education metadata, and (when available) the AI summary. Use after `search_jobs` when the user picks a specific role to discuss, or when the user pastes a HireJack job URL. Not for browsing or filtering postings (`search_jobs`) or personal fit scoring (`match_job`).

domain.description: Company domain (e.g. 'stripe.com'). Required unless `url` is provided.

jobId.description: Job canonical id — pass the `id` field from a `search_jobs` result VERBATIM (it may contain '#' separators, e.g. 'greenhouse#stripe#4921361'; keep them). The dashed URL form also works. Required unless `url` is provided.

url.description: Full HireJack job detail URL, e.g. 'https://hirejack.com/jobs/stripe.com/sw-eng-12345/'. Convenience alternative to passing `domain` + `jobId` separately.

name: get_job

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: The job posting (metadata only — description HTML is intentionally omitted; meta.gated marks postings the website would paywall)

ai_summary.description: 2-3 sentence AI summary when available (get_job only)

company_domain.description: e.g. 'stripe.com' — pass to get_company_profile or company_fit

education.description: Stated degree requirement, e.g. 'bachelor', or null

id.description: Raw canonical job id — pass back to get_job, match_job, save_job, or track_application

location.description: Normalized location, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA' or 'Remote (US)'

salary.description: Disclosed pay range, or null when the posting lists none

title.description: Standardized title when available, else the raw posting title

years_min.description: Minimum years of experience the posting asks for, or null

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: Get Job
